name: Markel Specialty
appetite_notes: Preferred: 1-50 attorneys, general practice, corporate, estate. Avoid: securities class actions, mass tort. Strong appetite for renewals with clean loss history.

name: Berkshire Professional
appetite_notes: Broad LPL appetite. Preferred: small-to-mid firms, 1-30 attorneys. Will consider litigation-heavy firms. Competitive on $1M/$1M limits. Strong renewals desk.

name: Ironshore Professional
appetite_notes: Preferred: mid-to-large firms, complex risk, higher limits ($2M+). Will consider securities, IP, and employment practices. Minimum $10,000 premium.

name: Hanover Professionals
appetite_notes: Solo and small firm specialists (1-10 attorneys). Competitive rates. Fast turnaround 24-48hrs. Preferred states: Southeast, Midwest. Prior acts coverage standard.

name: ProAssurance Specialty
appetite_notes: Broad LPL appetite. Particularly strong for family law, criminal defense, and estate planning. Competitive deductible options. 5-day quote turnaround SLA.

name: ALPS (Attorney Liability Protection Society)
appetite_notes: Program administrator specializing in small-to-mid law firms. Preferred: 1-20 attorneys, no securities or class actions. Excellent prior acts terms. AM Best A rated.

name: Travelers Specialty
appetite_notes: Large firm focus (15+ attorneys). Strong appetite for corporate, M&A, IP, and employment. Will quote securities with proper underwriting. Admitted paper in all states.

name: Chubb Professional Risk
appetite_notes: Premium market for large and complex firms. High limits capacity ($10M+). Securities, class action, and bet-the-company litigation. Thorough underwriting — allow 10 business days.

name: Axis Pro
appetite_notes: Mid-market specialist. 5-50 attorneys. Good appetite for litigation, real estate, and family law. Competitive on $1M/$2M and $1M/$3M towers. 3-day turnaround.

name: Nationwide E&S / Specialty
appetite_notes: Difficult-to-place risks and accounts with prior claims. Will consider declined accounts from standard markets. Higher deductibles required. Broad appetite for all firm sizes.
